noChangeDecisions: Do not replace oír/escuchar overlap with an absolute hearing-versus-listening ban.
Keep dictionary-form and score-free inflection retries; a valid feminine or inflected example is not itself a scoring defect.
Do not infer reciprocity: suelo floor excludes tierra soil; asumir responsibility excludes suponer assumption.
Broader teaching examples can show a different legitimate sense. Many are contrived, but that alone does not make their Spanish false.
Keep noun/adjective médico separate; doctor as noun does not fit adjective medical.
Keep libre/gratis and jugar/tocar selected-sense distinctions.
Do not remove extra accepted senses solely because a narrower usage is more common.
limitations: Full read-through is not exhaustive synonym certification. Primary checking is targeted. Candidate lists are evidence to investigate, not proposed automatic edits.
